name: Today's Catch
observations: Blue fascia with large white TODAY'S CATCH wording; smaller fish/chips/kebab/burger line visible in older native126.
Lower light-framed glazing includes transom strips, menu graphics and door near middle/right.
Pale lower panels and brick upper facade with white rectangular windows.
Continuous shallow tiled-looking roof, gutters and window rhythm shared with Specsavers/charity units.
2016 and later captures coexist; shop appearance/sign state must be kept dated.
Native126 shows the correct west row but has stale reported URL heading; do not project geometry from that heading.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
review_basis: All listed captures reviewed in contact sheets; selected originals also inspected at native resolution. Notes describe visible appearance, not surveyed construction.
placement_confidence: Approximate frontage marker derived from camera route, side and estimated offset; not a measured footprint.
